diagnosis: The release_contract_escrow function fetches EscrowContract solely by contract_id and invokes the release_funds FSM transition method without verifying that request.user is the designated buyer or mediator. Any authenticated marketplace user can trigger premature release of escrowed payment funds to a seller.

Host: marketplace.escrowbridge.net
